Table of the seasonality of a coin

Source: R/fct_plots.R
seasonality_table.Rd

A table with a row per group of seasonality_analysis(), in their natural order, with the numbers of the chart of plot_seasonality(). The mean and the median are shaded red below 0 and green above it, and the share up red below 50% and green above it, more strongly the further they are from the middle.

Usage

seasonality_table(analysis)

Arguments

analysis

The result of seasonality_analysis().

Value

A DT datatable.

Examples

btc <- get_history("Bitcoin (BTC)", as.Date("2013-04-29"))
seasonality_table(seasonality_analysis(btc, "month"))
